name: Raining Blood
body:
School necromancy; Level death mage 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a vial of blood)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area 20-ft. radius cylinder, 40 ft. high
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a downpour of blood in the area that deals 1d6 points of negative energy damage per caster level (maximum 15d6) to every living creature in the area.

Any corporeal undead or creature with the blood drain ability in the area is healed by 4d6. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage. For the remaining duration, the area is filled with the smell of putrid offal.

Any living creature entering or beginning their turn in the area must also make a Fortitude save or be sickened until the beginning of their next turn.
